reasons: Claimed status is compliant; cited p0001 expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties, which directly supports the preferred position of no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer.
No redline or comment is expected or provided for a compliant finding, and the rendered redline is identical to the original text — consistent with the claimed status.

Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction binding Customer remains; rationale correctly notes remaining 'shall not' language binds Kubient or is neutral/compliance-related rather than a restraint on our business.
Minor wording slip in the rationale (referring to 'AP' rather than the defined Customer) does not affect substance, as AP is the Customer.
